target.kind: disposable private repository created only for this run and deleted afterwards
target.protection: no branch protection, no required reviews, no merge queue

covered: gh reads the named repository and the current head of its base branch
gh reads one pull request and returns head sha, base ref, CI state and review decision
the frontier refreshes and plans a dry run against live pull request state
an operator clone pushes a branch and opens a pull request
the opened pull request is read back and its head sha matches the pushed commit
the pull request is closed and its branch deleted
GitHubCLI.merge runs `gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit` and the pull request reaches state MERGED
the merged commit is reachable from the base branch
notCovered: submitting a review or a change request
branch protection rules, required checks and required reviews
repository permission levels other than the operator account
concurrent delivery runs against the same pull request
boundary: One live create/read/close/merge cycle against an unprotected disposable repository with a single operator account. It does not establish behaviour under branch protection, review requirements or concurrent contention.
